Address: http://127.0.0.1:46517/
Title: What a scan reads
Pointer: 1082, 143

With only the folder's own ignore files applied, the scan will read **15,593 files** and leave out **1,651**.

The page first showed 17,244 files with nothing left out, because the 25 `.gitignore` and 15 `.tfignore` files it found weren't applied yet. I clicked "Take them in," which added their lines to the list and nothing else. The list is now built only from those files, and the counts above come from it.
